description:
FOUND s436 (Opus 5) by the Q2 four-population emission A/B, which is a
DIFFERENT instrument from the census: it byte-compares the emission of two
compilers over a file LIST, so it sees every file the flip touched, whatever
population the census happens to define.

MEASURED (base 9138404 vs the flip f702da3, every DIFF shape-checked to be
exactly the flip's one-line `nil` -> `p-die` substitution and nothing else):

  population                                   files  DIFF  flip sites
  lib/**.pm                                       22     0           0
  cpan-tests/modules/** (.pm and .t)             402    52         107
  $PCL_PERL_SUITE_T/*/*.t                        604    24          79

The 52 cpan DIFFs split 9 `.pm` / 43 `.t`, and the 9 `.pm` files reproduce the
blessed census ROW FOR ROW, count for count (15 sites).  The 43 `.t` files --
92 flip sites -- are in NO population the census defines:
tools/drop-census.pl's `cpan-tests` population is `cpan-tests/modules/**/*.pm`
only (module mode, because that is the emission the runtime caches).

The suite population is exactly the census's 23 rows, count for count, PLUS
t/japh/abigail.t (2 drops) -- the census follows run-perl-suite.pl's
@DEFAULT_DIRS, and `japh` is excluded there as "obfuscated".

WHY IT MATTERS NOW: post-flip those 94 sites DIE when reached.  The census is
the blessed baseline that prices the flip, and 94 of the sites it is supposed
to price are outside it.  Nothing regressed -- they were dropped silently
before -- but the price is uncounted, which is the exact sin #462 closed for
the two module populations.

THE DECISION (do not just widen the glob):
 (a) add `cpan-tests/modules/**/t/*.t` as a sixth population in PROGRAM mode.
     That is what those files are -- a dist's own test suite, run as programs.
     Cost: +~350 transpiles per census run (the census is ~3.5 min at 8 jobs
     for 658 files today).
 (b) leave them out and say so in the census header, with the count.
 (c) add japh/ too, or state that the census population IS the runner's dir
     list and japh is deliberately outside it.
Recommendation: (a) for the `.t` files (they run, and their rows are real), and
(c)-by-documentation for japh (nothing runs it; the two drops are in the same
`1 while -f ++$file` shape as the rest of the family-1 gap).

ACCEPTANCE: a census run reproduces 43 files / 92 drops for the new
population, the blessed TSV gains those rows with their causes, and the header
says which populations exist and which are deliberately outside.  Related:
#472 (the fresh_perl/runperl CHILD population, also uncounted, also exposed by
the flip).


=== s438 (Opus 5, 2026-08-23) DONE.  tools/drop-census.pl gained the `cpan-t`
population: every `.t` at any depth under a `t/` directory below
cpan-tests/modules (289 files; Test-Simple's suite nests four levels, so the
scan is recursive, not `**/t/*.t`), transpiled as a PROGRAM.  MEASURED 42 files
/ 83 drops, not the 43 / 92 this task predicted -- and the difference is
entirely POPULATION, not progress: the s436 A/B scanned every `.t` under
cpan-tests/modules, which is these 42 plus examples/tools.t (1 file, 9 drops,
all of them the same Test2 block-form family).  `xt/` and `examples/` are
author/release tests, not the dist's suite, and are named with that count in
the census header beside t/japh/ (option (b)+(c)-by-documentation of this
task's decision list, exactly as recommended).  Re-measured on an f702da3
worktree: the same 42 files / 83 drops there, so nothing moved since s436.

Blessed: docs/parse-error-drop-census-s399.tsv 39 files / 102 drops -> 81 /
185, the 36 non-board pre-existing rows byte-identical, header rewritten (six
populations; what is deliberately outside, with its measured size).

Two decisions inside it, both measured: (1) the dist `.t` files are transpiled
WITHOUT the dist's own lib/ + t/lib on @INC (tools/run-dist-t.pl adds them) --
the rows are identical either way, so the census stays uniform with its other
program-mode populations; (2) the tool now strips the repo root out of the
message TEXT, because PExpr's "unhandled postfix '->' term in F:" quotes the
file and the row otherwise depended on how ROOT was spelled on the command
line.

WHAT THE POPULATION FOUND: 79 of the 83 are ONE mechanism, filed as #478 (the
prototype pre-scan skips Test2::/Test:: BY NAME, so a `(&)` block-form call is
not parsed -- and the no-semicolon spelling is SILENTLY mis-parsed instead).
Residue: #480, #481, #482.  Two of the 289 files refuse to transpile at all
(Parser2 TODO refusals) and so contribute no rows; both are named in the
census header.
subject: The drop census does not count cpan-tests/modules/**/t/*.t: 43 files / 92 drops, measured by the s436 four-population A/B (and t/japh/, 1 file / 2 drops)
